title: svt_usb_transaction/svt_usb_types field-level detail, xHCI TRB modeling, and hub-mode gating
summary: svt_usb_transaction (svt_usb_transaction.sv:268, extends `SVT_TRANSACTION_TYPE) real fields confirm faithful spec-level SETUP/token modeling, not an abstracted byte-blob: rand bit[6:0] device_address; rand bit[3:0] endpoint_number; rand bit[15:0] usb_stream_id; rand svt_usb_types::transaction_type_enum xact_type=IN_TRANSACTION; the 8-byte USB SETUP packet mirrored 1:1 as rand setup_data_bmrequesttype_dir (HOST_TO_DEVICE default)/_type (STANDARD default)/_recipient (BMREQ_DEVICE default), rand bit[7:0] setup_data_brequest=GET_STATUS, rand bit[15:0] setup_data_w_value/w_index/w_length; rand bit[19:0] route_string (USB3 hub routing string, matches spec field width); rand device_response_enum device_response= RESPONSE_UNKNOWN and rand host_response_enum host_response=HOST_NORMAL_RESPONSE, each driven by paired int unsigned *_wt weight fields (NORMAL/NAK/STALL/NYET/ERR/TIMEOUT/RESPONSE_UNKNOWN/DEV_STREAM_SWITCH response weights); rand lpm_hird[3:0]/lpm_blinkstate[3:0]/lpm_bremotewake (LPM fields); rand device_connected_bus_speed (svt_usb_types::speed_enum, default SS) and device_connected_num_lanes (LANE_SUPPORT_1/2); svt_usb_types::split_xact_enum split_state= NO_SPLIT (FS/LS-behind-HS-hub split-transaction tracking); retry_due_to_{nak,stall,timeout,error,nyet}_cnt counters. Device/endpoint identity can be indirected through dev_ix_anchor/ep_ix_anchor list-index fields (with find_ix_anchor_values()/fix_anchors() extern methods) rather than literal addresses, letting constraints target 'some enumerated device/endpoint' generically. ~60 extern methods observed beyond standard svt_data object-services boilerplate (do_copy/do_compare/do_pack/do_unpack/byte_size/get_prop_val/etc.), including pre_randomize()/post_randomize(), reasonable_constraint_mode(bit on_off), get_xact_type_val()/get_device_address_val()/get_device_response_val()/get_endpoint_number_val()/get_usb_stream_id_val()/get_lpm_*_val() accessor family, get_packet_index(svt_usb_packet pkt), is_tx_packet(packet), is_ignore_ack_required(). svt_usb_transfer (svt_usb_transfer.sv:420, sibling extending `SVT_TRANSACTION_TYPE, 39% cleartext) and svt_usb_packet (svt_usb_packet.sv:39, sibling, 31.6% cleartext, 20841 lines -- the single largest per-class file after configuration) were confirmed to exist and extend the same base but were NOT field-walked in depth in this pass -- flagged as the highest-value follow-on target (PID/CRC5/CRC16/CRC32/ordered-set framing fields live in svt_usb_packet). svt_usb_types (svt_usb_types.sv:276, a bare namespace class extending nothing, 62.2% cleartext -- the highest fraction of any class file since enum bodies are almost never encrypted) holds ~90 typedef enum declarations used VIP-wide; verified members include dut_type_enum {DUT_NOT_APPLICABLE, DUT_USB_HOST, DUT_USB_DEVICE, DUT_USB_OTG_A, DUT_USB_OTG_B, DUT_USB_HUB_DFP, DUT_USB_HUB_UFP, DUT_USB_PHY}; speed_enum {LS, FS, HS, SS, ESSG2, ESSG1X2, ESSG2X2} (Enhanced-SS Gen2/Gen1x2/Gen2x2 dual-lane, some members gated by SVT_USB_TEST_SUITE_XHCI_DRIVER_COMPILE/SVT_USB_TEST_SUITE_RTL_DUT); ep_type_enum:bit[1:0] {CONTROL, BULK, INTERRUPT, ISOCHRONOUS}; ep_direction_enum:bit {OUT, IN}; number_of_lanes_support_enum {LANE_SUPPORT_1, LANE_SUPPORT_2}; usb4_port_speed_type_enum:bit[3:0] {USB4_PORT_SPEED_GEN2, _GEN3, _GEN4}; otg_role_swap_status_enum {NOT_OTG_CAPABLE, OTG_HOST, OTG_DEVICE, OTG_A_ACTING_AS_DEVICE, OTG_B_ACTING_AS_HOST, OTG_A_INITIATED_ROLE_SWAP_IN_PROGRESS, OTG_B_INITIATED_ROLE_SWAP_IN_PROGRESS}; plus ~80 more state/mode enums for LTSSM (link20sm/link30sm/ltssm_substate), eUSB2/eUSB2v2 repeater and rate-negotiation states, HSIC/UTMI xcvr states, and error-insertion taxonomies -- full verified list in the companion report section 14. xHCI host-controller modeling: svt_usb_xhci_trb (svt_usb_xhci_trb.sv:13, extends `SVT_TRANSACTION_TYPE, 22.1% clear), svt_usb_xhci_td (svt_usb_xhci_td.sv:30, extends svt_status, 54.6% clear), svt_usb_xhci_trb_ring (svt_usb_xhci_trb_ring.sv:34, extends svt_status, 45.7% clear) confirm a genuine TRB/TD/Ring modeling layer exists, tied to svt_usb_device_configuration's xhci_slot_context_hub/xhci_slot_context_number_of_ports fields -- relevant for host-mode verification against an xHCI-based DUT host controller, not just signal-level UTMI/PIPE modeling. Not field-walked in depth (follow-on target). Hub support: svt_usb_hub_agent (svt_usb_hub_agent.sv:32, class name is macro SVT_USB_HUB_SUBENV_TYPE, only 11.7% clear -- heavily encrypted) and svt_usb_hub_agent_configuration (extends svt_usb_configuration directly) exist as a PARALLEL agent hierarchy in its own SVT_USB_HUB_SUBENV_* macro namespace, distinct from the main SVT_USB_SUBENV_* agent macros, and gated everywhere by `ifdef SVT_USB_ENABLE_HUB_MODE (a compile-time opt-in feature, not always compiled into the VIP). svt_usb_protocol.sv (extends svt_xactor) is only 5.0% cleartext -- the endpoint/isoc scheduler algorithm (across svt_usb_protocol_scheduler.sv, svt_usb_protocol_genb_scheduler.sv, svt_usb_protocol_*_ep_processor*.sv, all similarly encrypted) is NOT extractable from source in this VIP release; scheduler behavior must come from simulation observation or vendor docs, not source inspection.
